false_positive_prevention_rules.condition: capability_matrix_update field is absent from a Tier 1 work item
false_positive_prevention_rules.correct_behavior: DOWNGRADE to ACCEPT_WITH_LIMITATIONS — do not trigger FAIL or STOP
false_positive_prevention_rules.wrong_behavior: STOP execution or mark as REJECTED

false_positive_prevention_rules.condition: ledger_entry_id is null in a transcript for a non-src-editing item (dry-run or governance work)
false_positive_prevention_rules.correct_behavior: WARNING only — do not trigger FAIL

false_positive_prevention_rules.condition: actual_files_changed is empty in a dry-run transcript
false_positive_prevention_rules.correct_behavior: ACCEPTED — dry-run mode intentionally makes no file changes
Accepted as expected outcome — not a sprint failure
false_positive_prevention_rules.wrong_behavior: Sprint FAIL because a fixture returned FAIL

false_positive_prevention_rules.correct_behavior: Sprint continues as valid — KEEP_DEFERRED is an accepted outcome
false_positive_prevention_rules.wrong_behavior: Sprint FAIL because MCP was not promoted

false_positive_prevention_rules.condition: Tier 3 or Tier 4 item missing source_diff_path
false_positive_prevention_rules.correct_behavior: ACCEPTED — governance/planning work does not produce source diffs

false_positive_prevention_rules.condition: External skill evaluation artifacts have no transcript or ledger entry
false_positive_prevention_rules.correct_behavior: ACCEPTED — W10 items use EXEMPT_PREFIXES (W10-EVIDENCE) and are exempt from transcript/ledger requirements
false_positive_prevention_rules.wrong_behavior: REJECTED for missing transcript on W10 items

allowable_limitations: Missing ledger_entry_id for dry-run or governance work → WARNING
